summary.text: Kathy Landing is a Republican state representative from Mount Pleasant who has represented South Carolina House District 80 since November 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A financial advisor and former Mount Pleasant town councilwoman, Landing serves on the Judiciary and Government Efficiency and Legislative Oversight committees.

paragraphs.text: Landing was born in New Orleans and earned a B.S. from Duke University in 1983 and an M.S. from the College for Financial Planning in 2005.
She has been senior vice president of investments at Raymond James since 2008.
She served on the Mount Pleasant Town Council from 2017 to 2021.
Landing took office on November 14, 2022, succeeding Jermaine Johnson.
In the November 3 general election she faces Democrat Benjamin Brown.
